versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02093 At a call to Com_SendDynSignal , the AUTOSAR COM module shall set the length of the corresponding dynamic length I-PDU to the smallest length that includes the 77 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 dynamic length signal. The length of the dynamic signal shall be equal to the value of input parameter "Length" passed in the API Com_SendDynSignal .
